> A compact electronic reaction game where the player must quickly press the button corresponding to the illuminated LED. A Raspberry Pi Pico controls the LEDs, buttons, and buzzer while tracking the player's reaction and providing visuals and audio feedback. The game can be programmed with different difficulty levels and reaction challenges, all built into a custom-designed PCB.
